post.description: Finding used or new cars for sale near a US ZIP or nationwide, filtering for clean-history or 1-owner cars, comparing prices against Carfax's value, or listing a dealer's inventory. Chain vin into get_listing for price history, features and dealer comments.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

condition.description:
Default used.

Provider reference: allowed values ["used", "new", "any"].

dealer_id.description: Carfax dealer id (dealer.id from a listing) to list one dealer's inventory; use with condition any for its full stock. Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9]{6,16}$.

make.description: Make name as Carfax spells it, e.g. Honda, Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover. An unknown make returns no results.

model.description: Model name, e.g. Civic, F-150, Grand Cherokee. Needs make.

no_accidents.description: Only vehicles with no accident or damage reported to Carfax.

page.description:
1-based page of 25; Carfax serves at most 50 pages.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

radius_miles.description:
Radius around zip; default 50. Needs zip.

Provider reference: allowed values ["10", "25", "50", "75", "100", "150", "200", "250", "500"].

sort.description:
Default best (Carfax's best match).

Provider reference: allowed values ["best", "price_asc", "price_desc", "mileage_asc", "mileage_desc", "year_desc", "year_asc"].

zip.description: US ZIP the radius is centred on. Omit for a nationwide search. A ZIP Carfax cannot resolve is invalid_input. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

200.description:
Search cars for sale on CARFAX. Returns one page of up to 25 listings with VIN, year/make/model/trim, mileage, price, Carfax History-Based Value and price rating, the free history highlights (accidents reported, owner count, 1-owner, personal use, service records, last service), specs, photo, distance and dealer, plus the total result count and next page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listings` | object[] |  |
| `next_page` | number | Next page number, or null on the last reachable page (Carfax serves at most 50 pages). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `search_area` | object | Resolved search location; null for nationwide searches. |
| `site_url` | string | The same search on carfax.com. |
| `total_pages` | number |  |
| `total_results` | number |  |
